goal.summary: Build an LLM companion to the off-the-pace React app that can (a) drive the app (open and redirect to pages), (b) explain what the user sees from the Mintlify docs and the page methodology, and (c) answer data questions and show the data it queried.
use_cases_in_build_order: Case 3: explain what the user is looking at (no SQL, answered from the page's methodology text)
Case 1: ask a question and get a table (the natural-language query page)
Case 4: explain a result on the page
Case 5: find something interesting (last, highest risk)

repos.note: The React versions differ, so port logic, not components.

items.decision: Do not copy the React app into this repo. Test here against the app's exported files.
No tunnel or relay yet. The browser calls Ollama through a dev proxy.
No gold or silver tables for now: they are not materialised as Parquet on disk, and they are shaped for ML.
No raw telemetry: the app itself never exports it (7.2 GB).
Start with a read-only natural-language query page on the Query Lab engine, before navigation.
Local model gpt-oss:20b on Ollama is the default, because the Cloudflare free quota ran out on 17 Oct.
Keep off-the-pace read-only: no edits there.
The three views (v_corners, v_stints, v_driver_season_skill) live in the adapter for now. Port to dbt in the data repo only after the views prove out and with the owner's OK.
The 20k-character value-list prompt is archived (archive-value-lists-22k/); plain raw-table schema is the baseline.
The 3-query harness cap is a diagnostic, not a product decision.

Join circuits on race_to_track.track_id = dim_circuits.circuit_key (173 matches). dim_circuits.circuit_id is a different slug and matches nothing. Details: experiments/04-companion-adapter/DATA_MAP.md.
The companion reads the app's exports and never writes to the app; off-the-pace stays read-only.
Use the app's own SQL (app/src/features/*/queries.ts) as the companion's data tools instead of model-written SQL. Spike: experiments/05-app-queries/.
Driver names live in a companion-side map (experiments/05-app-queries/driver_names.json), not in the app. The map was written from memory and is unverified.
The schema prompt is skipped in the tool spike; the model sees only the tool definitions.

Repo layout: numbered folders in experiments/, code used by two or more experiments in experiments/_shared/, retired material in _archive/. No top-level eval/. See experiments/06-session-handoff-2026-10-19/LAYOUT.md.

entries: Full account: experiments/06-session-handoff-2026-10-19/SESSION.md. Layout decisions: experiments/06-session-handoff-2026-10-19/LAYOUT.md.

Built the companion eval set experiments/04-companion-adapter/companion_questions.json: 8 scored questions (3 explain-page, 5 lookup). Two contested items excluded: c3_clean_lap_filter (methodology text vs queries.ts disagree on anomaly flags) and c1_consistency_lowest_sd (fct_driver_skill_features is one row per driver per race, not per season).

Built the harness in experiments/04-companion-adapter/: run.mjs (one master system prompt, run_sql, temperature 0, MAX_TURNS 6, MAX_SQL cap default 3) and adapter.mjs (gold Parquet in Node DuckDB). Env switches: VIEWS, SCHEMA_VALUES, QUESTIONS, RUNS_FILE, SUMMARY_FILE, REPEATS, ONLY, TRACE_ID/TRACE_TO.

Results: plain raw schema 24/24 (3 repeats). Raw with value lists (22.8k chars) 24/24, archived. Views on 21/24; only failure c1_lap_rows_2024 (no lap table in the views). View row counts match source with 0 join failures (VIEWS_CHECK.md).

Add new decisions with their date. Add a numbered ADR in docs/decisions/ only for a lasting choice.

prototype.what_it_is: A browser chat that answers questions about 2024 F1 laps and results. The model writes DuckDB SQL through run_sql. DuckDB-WASM runs the SQL in the browser on Parquet served by server/serve-data.mjs (port 8000). The model answers from the rows, and can call make_chart (bar or line). Prompt-work detail: experiments/03-prompt-rewrite/ (README, FINDINGS, TRIALS).
model_setup: Default is the local model gpt-oss:20b-f1 on Ollama (port 11434), built from experiments/_shared/ollama/Modelfile (20k context, 8k output).

VITE_PROVIDER=cloudflare npm run dev sends chats to the Worker (worker/), which calls Workers AI. The free daily quota (10,000 neurons) ran out on 17 Oct, so the Worker returns error 4006 until it resets.
The RULES block is gone from web/src/chat.ts. All behaviour rules live in DATA_GUIDE in web/src/dataGuide.ts. With the guide off, the model gets only the opening line, the tools and the schema.

current_state.only_failure_guide_on: Bahrain pace. The model's answer is right (96.537 s), but the scorer expects 96.5365 to the 4th decimal. Scorer issue, not model.
current_state.uncommitted_at_handoff: Commit 41666a8 (23:24, 17 Oct) holds the earlier prompt work. The fix-agent guide, the trial-log entries and the archive folder were not committed yet.
current_state.companion_eval_2026_10_19: Companion harness reads the gold Parquet via adapter.mjs. Plain raw schema 24/24; views on 21/24; braking 0/3 with views on. See prototype.companion_eval.

known_problems: 1. Chart can't show two drivers. make_chart takes one x and one y and has no series option. Asking for Verstappen vs Norris lap times draws one line that zigzags, with no legend. Pit laps (about 115 to 118 s) are not excluded.
2. Braking and other non-data questions should get 'the data doesn't cover it', and the app should not chart anything. Not yet tested in the browser.
3. Unanswerable questions sometimes name a driver while refusing (guide off).
4. Unsettled Q10 count: 138 (classified finishers lapped, per the notes) vs 144 (a recount). The data has exactly 138 rows with status 'Lapped'.
5. Q7 chart (points by driver) is checked only by its text, not the drawn bars.
6. Scorer: Bahrain rounding; 'Seven' written as a word is now accepted.
7. Companion: views have no lap table, so c1_lap_rows_2024 fails (model says not covered).

8. Companion: braking question 0/3 with views on. Model guesses driver_id (verstappen, max_verstappen; stored code is VER) and the driver list is not in the schema. The expected 748.14 m (53-lap mean) is not settled.
9. Companion: the cap stop message was misread as a row limit; wording to be fixed.
10. Companion scorer: refusals that name a driver are marked check manually; rule change not approved. parseNumbers minus-sign bug fixed.
next_steps_agreed_not_built: A series option on make_chart (a column to split by, with a legend), so multi-line charts work in general.

A custom lap-comparison tool, e.g. compare_lap_times(race, driver_a, driver_b), that runs fixed SQL, excludes pit laps and returns both series. Use it for driver comparisons; run_sql stays the fallback.
A declarative chart spec (series, colours, axis labels, reference lines) rendered by Recharts. Do not let the model write Recharts or JSX code.
Re-run the 14-question eval after any prompt change, guide on and off, and check the chart questions by hand in the browser.

Companion: add driver_id value list to views; add a lap view or raw fallback; fix cap wording; decide braking definition; approve or reject refusal rule; rerun the full set and uncovered-v2 with views on and off.

watch_out_for: Ollama's /v1 endpoint cannot set context size per request. That's why experiments/_shared/ollama/Modelfile bakes in num_ctx 20480. Without it, prompts were silently cut to 4096 tokens.
The driver_seasons table covers 2018 to 2025. Always join it with season = 2024, or totals multiply by 8.
Ollama's gpt-oss sometimes calls tools that don't exist (e.g. container.exec). The app should return an error to the model rather than crash. Not fixed yet.
race_id is text like 2024_16; corner names are Turn_1 in the data.
Join circuits on race_to_track.track_id = dim_circuits.circuit_key; dim_circuits.circuit_id matches nothing.
fct_driver_skill_features is one row per driver per race, not per season.
